group_rule: Connected components: |delta Zn|<=0.2, |delta Mg|<=0.1, |delta Cu|<=0.1 wt.% OR shared primary article/research line; transitive closure; no targets used. Does not authenticate unknown experiments.
fitting: Target-specific train-only median and scaling, never label imputation.
inherited_fits: Original 188x45 input matrix and property values unchanged; exact comparison passed.
external: All six Yin2025 Table1 condition/direction means, selected by availability of post-2023 primary tensile data, withheld from all selection and fitting. No cherry-picking of directions.
selection: Nested choice among raw/augmented ET, RF, SVR and Ridge configurations; this is a retrospective robustness check, not certification of historical choices.
